purpose: Reusable domain vocabulary and relationship pack for progressively composing complex real-estate CRUD forms. It is not a canonical ontology, physical schema or fixed classification tree.
normative_rules: Terms may participate in multiple facets and multiple relationship types.
No term is restricted to one parent or one path.
UI hints are presentation metadata only and do not define semantic truth.
Source-specific and jurisdictional terms are preserved and may remain unmapped.
Unknown or unmapped terms must not be dropped.
Relationships drive progressive disclosure; they do not imply canonical equivalence.
